summary: The diff shows work toward a hidden YouTube player hook using the exact requested URL, with logic to initialize the YouTube IFrame API once, queue a pending play if the user interacts before readiness, and attempt unmute/play when ready. However, the main hook file is truncated, so key acceptance-criteria behaviors (first-interaction event handling and unmute retry-on-next-gesture) cannot be fully verified from the provided evidence. Two non-functional/meta files were also modified without being requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Updated generated/metadata documentation files (frontend-file-summaries.txt and project_state.json) even though the BuildRequest only asked for frontend behavior changes related to hidden YouTube playback.
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement requested updating repo summary/metadata files; these changes are not necessary to satisfy REQ-35/REQ-36 and are outside the stated scope.
